title: Listening and Following Instructions
introduction: Learn about listening and following instructions through simple examples and practice.
definition: An instruction tells us what to do. Listen carefully before acting.
rules: Ask a grown-up to read: Stand up. Sit down. Clap your hands.
Listen and do each action in order.

examples.question: Complete: Sit ___.
steps: Read or listen to the question. Think about what you have learnt.

summary: An instruction tells us what to do. Listen carefully before acting.
